scope: Make collection discovery reversible and help readers widen an empty result without discarding all choices.
changes: Topic, area, sort and reset actions create reversible history entries; typing is grouped into one search step, with new sessions after submit or blur.
Back and Forward restore controls, visible cards, counts and removable-filter state from the URL.
Topic counts show the matches available within the current search and area; empty topics remain navigable.
Readers can remove only search, topic or area; focus returns to the corresponding control.
Input composition completes before filtering Odia or other composed text.
Filtering retains card/image DOM nodes in place; only a sort change reorders them.
All entries and ordinary links remain in the no-script document; existing photo sizes, credit and save identities are retained.

verification.publication_scope: Same 67 routes and 54 Explore entries; indexing disabled.

findings.issue: An additional coastal test run omitted the analytics environment variable used to build the site, causing its existing analytics configuration assertion to fail.
findings.resolution: Preserved failed output, then reran with matching PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID; all 44 coastal tests passed. Analytics implementation unchanged.

limitations: Same assistant implemented and verified the candidate; no independent review claimed.
Controller event tests use a synthetic DOM/history harness. They do not establish rendered layout, native keyboard or browser history scroll restoration behavior.
Earlier browser security-policy verification remains unavailable; no alternate browser bypass attempted. Real browser, screen-reader and physical-device checks remain open.
No content expansion, imagery changes, new routes, analytics change or search activation. Normal publication remains noindex.
